review.gallery: 14 visually reviewed native-resolution project renders extracted from the Cedarwood Estates South-branded brochure. Individual villa front/rear labels follow the brochure’s four-, five- and six-bedroom pages. Common interiors are described as published for the phase, with no claim of a delivered unit. No stock lifestyle cutaways, blank background textures or card badges are used.
review.location: The original phase-specific typology map is retained with its key and source page. Current official shared-page journey estimates were checked on 7 November 2026. The shared embedded map provides no verified phase entrance, so named directions are used. https://www.wasl.ae/en/project/cedarwood-estates
review.floorPlans: Six complete South-specific sheets cover three whole villas. The saleable total is repeated across level choices and counted once. Printed totals differ from the decimal floor-component sums. These South layouts have different areas from the original Cedarwood phase. Confirm the exact villa’s contractual area with Wasl. All printed numerical panels and original whole pages were visually reviewed. Broker-hosted copies remain explicitly labelled in the page’s source metadata.
review.provenance: Fresh fetch receipts with SHA-256 and exact source kind are in artifacts/project-page-enhancement/wasl-sources.log. Original PDFs and visual evidence are retained per project. Original text research and protected ownership are preserved.
review.cardSelection: 8 November 2026: the proposed South four-bedroom villa rear (cedarwood-estates-south-four-bedroom-rear) now supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover, superseding the original cover selection. The four-bedroom rear elevation and pool distinguish this card from the original Cedarwood frontage; the South-branded, Rapid Deals-hosted brochure attribution still applies. Own source: https://www.rapiddealsuae.com/jumeirah-golf-estates/documents/cedar-brochure.pdf#page=27. Only the card selection changes; original gallery assets, source attribution and image-scope qualifications remain unchanged.
